status: descriptive post-hoc endpoint timing audit; association is not attribution

comparison.evaluation_sets: exactly the same first90 experience validation sets at both checkpoints
comparison.within_experience_intervals: adjacent acquisition checkpoints use the same validation set within each experience; cross-experience endpoint changes are not treated as same-sample comparisons

limitations: Stored paired replay probes bracket the optimizer update and recycling together; they do not isolate the instantaneous reset effect.
Probe examples change between monitoring windows; replay damage is max(0,(CE_after-CE_before)/max(CE_before,0.1)), not an unbounded relative percent when CE_before<0.1.
No-reset updates can still involve recently reset newborn units, their gain floor, momentum, and the ungated classification head.
All runs reset3 units at step2000, and all final paired probes show zero positive damage; this does not prove that the isolated reset effect is zero because update effects can offset it.
The selected anomaly and time window are post-hoc; this audit does not change endpoints or select hyperparameters.
